title: [Fabric] Fix synchronization progress page name
summary: Fabric mirroring lifecycle messages now reference the correct page name 'Fabric Synchronization Overview' instead of 'Export Summary', with corresponding test updates.
key_points: Corrected user-facing messages in Connect, Start, Stop, and Reset lifecycle operations to match actual page name
Updated four test cases to expect the corrected page name in messages

Low-risk change affecting messages and tests only, no logic modifications
quote: Fabric mirroring lifecycle messages direct users to "Export Summary", but the page is named "Fabric Synchronization Overview".
